english.title: Allow filth / dirt / lime / offensive matter to run / flow onto the highway from adjoining premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, allowed filth, dirt, lime or other offensive matter or thing to run or flow onto a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), from adjoining premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 161(4) of the Highways Act 1980.
